adrs.text:
# 0058. OpenAPI document and generated client

- Status: Accepted
- Date: 2026-10-17

## Override

- Override: `@nestjs/swagger>js-yaml` 5.4.3
- Remove when: an @nestjs/swagger release depends on js-yaml >=5.4.1

## Context

dependenciesMd:
| Package | Purpose | Phase |
|---|---|---|
| `@nestjs/swagger` | OpenAPI document | P4 |
| `orval` | Client generator | P4 |
| `js-yaml` (5.4.3 for @nestjs/swagger only, pnpm override; ADR 0058) | Patched transitive dependency | P4 |
lockfile:
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

overrides:
  '@nestjs/swagger>js-yaml': 5.4.3

importers:

  apps/api:
    dependencies:
      '@nestjs/swagger':
        specifier: 11.4.7
        version: 11.4.7(@nestjs/common@11.2.7)

packages:

  '@nestjs/swagger@11.4.7':
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-x}

  js-yaml@4.3.2:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-x}

  js-yaml@5.4.3:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-x}

  orval@8.41.0:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-x}

snapshots:

  '@nestjs/swagger@11.4.7(@nestjs/common@11.2.7)':
    dependencies:
      '@nestjs/common': 11.2.7
      js-yaml: 5.4.3
      lodash: 4.18.1

  js-yaml@4.3.2:
    dependencies:
      argparse: 2.0.1

  js-yaml@5.4.3:
    dependencies:
      argparse: 2.0.1

  orval@8.41.0:
    dependencies:
      js-yaml: 4.3.2
